title: Preparation and Structural Properties of Novel Fluorenophanes
abstract: Abstract                All kinds of fluorenophanes with bridging at 1,7-, 1,8-, and 2,7-positions of each fluorene unit have been successfully prepared. Dynamic structural properties clearly depend on the positions of the bridges. It has been found out that one (2,7)-bridged fluorene ring in the [2.2](1,8)(2,7)fluorenophane is bent to result in formation of the π-cavity.
